titulo: Special Ops Convention Convenes Under 'Peace Through Strength' Strategy
descricao: More than 29,000 members of the military's special operations forces community and the public converged in person on Tampa, Fla., and virtually to kick off Special Operations Forces Week 2026.

titulo: National Defense Strategy Prioritizes America First, Leader Says
descricao: The U.S. will prioritize theaters with the greatest consequence for national interests and where only American power can play a decisive role, said Daniel Zimmerman, assistant secretary of war for international security affairs, who spoke during a hearing before the House Armed Services Committee.

titulo: Coast Guard's Newest Polar Icebreaker Returns Home Following Arctic Deployment
descricao: The Coast Guard cutter Storis completed a 36-day Bering Sea deployment to test its capabilities and train for high-risk Arctic missions.

titulo: At Fort Campbell, Hegseth Underscores Significance of Purple Hearts, Enlistments
descricao: During a visit with the 101st Airborne Division at Fort Campbell, Ky., as part of its "Week of the Eagles" celebration, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth administered the oath of enlistment to a handful of screaming eagle soldiers and pinned Purple Heart medals to the chests of nine others.

titulo: Army Advances Barracks Modernization Efforts to Improve Quality of Life
descricao: The Army has accelerated efforts to strengthen quality-of-life investments across installations, showing a long-term commitment to ensuring soldiers live and work in facilities that reflect the professionalism, standards and readiness expectations of the service.

titulo: Fueling the Fight: USNS Kanawha Completes Strategic Deployment
descricao: Family and friends gathered on the pier at Naval Station Norfolk, Va., to welcome home the crew of the USNS Kanawha. The fleet replenishment oiler and its 92 civil service mariners returned after a 204-day deployment, including 156 days at sea.

titulo: High-Pressure Field Artillery Creates Bonds Between Soldiers
descricao: Behind the massive firepower of field artillery are tight-knit soldiers driven by deep trust and family-like bonds.

titulo: Hegseth Welcomes Ford Carrier Strike Group Home After Record-Breaking Deployment
descricao: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth was on hand with his wife, Jennifer, and numerous senior Navy leaders at Naval Station Norfolk, Va., to welcome home sailors assigned to USS Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group after a record-setting, multi-month deployment.

titulo: Pentagon Marks Armed Forces Day With Special Flag
descricao: The War Department celebrated Armed Forces Day with a newly unveiled America 250 version of the Betsy Ross flag, unfurled over the outside of the Pentagon.

titulo: Future USS Cleveland Sailors Attend Commissioning Week Events
descricao: Sailors assigned to the future USS Cleveland, the 16th and final Freedom-variant littoral combat ship to be built and commissioned for the Navy, arrived in their namesake city to launch a week of community engagement and celebration leading up to the ship's commissioning.

titulo: Africom Commander Says Continent at 'Crossroads' of Global Commerce, Security
descricao: Air Force Gen. Dagvin R.M. Anderson, commander of U.S. Africa Command, told Congress that as Africa ascends on the world stage, it faces a precarious situation due to bad actors operating throughout the region.

titulo: Centcom Commander Says Epic Fury Crippled Iran, Enhanced Military Partnerships in Region
descricao: Since the launch of Operation Epic Fury, American forces in the U.S. Central Command area of operations crippled Iran's military and its ability to project power, according to War Department leaders.

titulo: Air Force Pilots Receive Distinguished Flying Cross for Midnight Hammer Heroics
descricao: Six F-16 Fighting Falcon pilots assigned to the 55th Fighter Squadron received the Distinguished Flying Cross for their heroic actions in combat operations during a ceremony at Shaw Air Force Base, S.C.

titulo: Senior Leaders Update Congress on Special Ops Community
descricao: Four of the most senior leaders from the U.S. military's special operations forces community appeared before the Senate Armed Services Committee in Washington to provide an update on the SOF components within their respective branches of service.

titulo: U.S., Multinational Allies Launch Exercise Salaknib's Second Phase in the Philippines
descricao: The Army's 25th Infantry Division, in close partnership with the Armed Forces of the Philippines and multinational allies, officially launched the Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center-Exportable Exercise, Part II of the bilateral Exercise Salaknib.

titulo: Army, Forest Service Complete Annual Prescribed Burn in Hawaii
descricao: U.S. Army Garrison Hawaii and the U.S. Forest Service successfully completed the annual prescribed burn of the training area at Schofield Barracks, Hawaii, treating approximately 1,707 acres of invasive vegetation to reduce wildfire risk and maintain the integrity of military training lands.

titulo: Washington National Guard Aviation Crews Train for Wildfire Season
descricao: Aviation crews assigned to the 1st Battalion, 168th Aviation Regiment, Washington Army National Guard, partnered with Central Pierce Fire and Rescue to conduct water bucket training near Puyallup, Wash., preparing for the state's wildfire season.

titulo: Hegseth Welcomes South Korean Counterpart to Pentagon
descricao: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth welcomed South Korean Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back to Washington for a bilateral engagement at the Pentagon.

titulo: Partner Nations Hammer Out Foundation for Digital Transformation at Leadership Summit
descricao: The Five Eyes alliance concluded its Digital Leadership Summit at the Pentagon, focusing on Project Arcadia to synchronize digital transformation and enhance data supremacy for coalition forces.

titulo: Forging Tactical Readiness During Iron Ascent
descricao: The 92nd Air Refueling Wing launched Iron Ascent, a three-day tactical training course at Fairchild Air Force Base, Washington, that enabled airmen from various career fields to operate as capable expeditionary warfighters.

titulo: Blount Island Command's Ship-to-Shore Operations Reinforces Southcom Readiness
descricao: Marines landed an MK36 Wrecker tactical armored vehicle at Marine Corps Support Facility Blount Island in Jacksonville, Fla., demonstrating how the service rapidly moves equipment to support operations across the region.

titulo: Joint Force Provides Post-Typhoon Relief in Pacific
descricao: Sailors and Marines assigned to the USS Boxer Amphibious Ready Group and the 11th Marine Expeditionary Unit supported Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands' civil and local authorities in their recovery efforts from Super Typhoon Sinlaku.

titulo: Utah National Guard Integrates Air, Ground Capabilities During Exercise Wolverine
descricao: Exercise Wolverine at Camp Williams, Utah, focused on strengthening joint interaction between Utah Army and Air National Guard units for disaster response and air-to-ground operations to support homeland defense.

titulo: 'Project Freedom' Aims to Get Thousands of Commercial Ships Safely Through Strait of Hormuz
descricao: Project Freedom is a targeted U.S. military mission to break the Iranian blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and restore the safe flow of international shipping and oil.

titulo: 82nd Airborne Division Ready to Respond, Support Project Freedom, Caine Says
descricao: When the president or the secretary of war needs immediate, scalable and lethal combat power anywhere in the world, 82nd Airborne Division paratroopers answer the call, Air Force Gen. Dan Caine, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, said during a Pentagon press briefing.

titulo: Enlistees Honored During Recognition Ceremony
descricao: As the nation commemorates its 250th anniversary throughout 2026, community and military leaders honored the next generation of American defenders during the second annual Our Community Salutes Enlistee Recognition Ceremony at the First Baptist Church in O'Fallon, Ill.

titulo: 80 Years After Death, Medal of Honor Recipient Identified, Buried
descricao: More than 80 years after his death, Medal of Honor recipient Army Capt. Willibald Bianchi's remains were identified by the Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency, he was buried in his hometown alongside his parents and his sisters.

titulo: West Virginia Guardsmen Awarded Medals for Heroism in Nation's Capital
descricao: Two West Virginia National Guardsmen were recognized in the Pentagon's Hall of Heroes for actions late last year while working as part of Joint Task Force District of Columbia — an effort directed by President Donald J. Trump to stop crime in the nation's capital and to beautify the city.

titulo: Exercise Desert Hammer Prepares Citizen Airmen for 'Trial by Fire'
descricao: Airmen assigned to the 944th Fighter Wing participated in Exercise Desert Hammer 26-2, training designed to build battlefield skills, test mission-essential tasks and prepare reserve airmen for operations beyond base, at Camp Navajo, Ariz.

titulo: Personal Property Activity Launches Moving Website
descricao: The War Department's Personal Property Activity launches its new website, www.ppa.mil, creating a centralized digital hub designed to better support DOW personnel and industry partners as they navigate the moving process.

titulo: Nevada Guard's Civil Support Team Trains for Radiological, Explosive Threats
descricao: The Nevada National Guard's 92nd Civil Support Team conducted its annual "Beta Burn" exercise at the Ormsby House in Carson City, training alongside local and federal partners to respond to simulated radiological and explosive threats.

titulo: Reauthorizations Accelerate Tech for War Department
descricao: The reauthorization of a couple of small business technology programs opens the gates for the War Department to get cutting-edge technology more quickly into the hands of warfighters.

titulo: National Guard Military Police Battalion Deploys in Support of Operation Epic Fury
descricao: Approximately 150 soldiers assigned to the 192nd Military Police Battalion, Connecticut Army National Guard, participated in a deployment ceremony after being selected to deploy on short notice to the Middle East in support of Operation Epic Fury.

titulo: Socom Keeps America Safe With Wide Focus
descricao: America's Special Operations Command has eyes and ears around the world focused on a variety of hotspots and threats that may put the well-being and safety of the homeland at risk.

titulo: Multinational Forces Validate Defensive Readiness During Exercise Balikatan 2026
descricao: Over 500 service members from the U.S., Philippines, Australia and New Zealand successfully coordinated fires from land and air to defeat a simulated adversary attack during Balikatan 2026, exemplifying the "shoulder-to-shoulder" spirit of the exercise.

titulo: Training in Close Air Support Keeps Idaho Airmen 'Always Ready'
descricao: Airmen assigned to the 124th Air Support Operations Squadron, Idaho Air National Guard, conducted close air support training at the 188th Wing's Razorback Range at Fort Chaffee Joint Maneuver Training Center, Ark.

titulo: Army Medic Leads Life-Saving Response After Bear Attack in Alaska
descricao: During a training exercise, Army Sgt. Zachariah Clark relied on his expertise as a combat medic to lead a life-saving rescue and triage effort after two fellow soldiers were mauled by a bear in the Alaskan wilderness.

titulo: Navy Commissions Submarine USS Idaho
descricao: The Navy commissioned the submarine USS Idaho in a traditional ceremony at Naval Submarine Base New London in Groton, Conn., bringing cutting-edge warfighting capability to the nation's undersea forces after a multiyear construction process.

titulo: Eyes, Ears of Joint Force: Caine Honors Unsung Intelligence Community Heroes
descricao: Successful military operations depend on those in the intelligence community, including the Defense Intelligence Agency, National Security Agency, National Reconnaissance Office, Central Intelligence Agency and others, said Air Force Gen. Dan Caine, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.

titulo: Joint Force Enforces Maritime Blockade in Gulf of Oman, Globally
descricao: The Navy is enforcing a growing global blockade to seize ships doing business with Iran and has authorized lethal force to protect maritime interests.

titulo: Thousands of Kids Descend on Pentagon for 'Bring Your Child to Work Day'
descricao: More than 8,000 children visited the Pentagon for "Bring Your Child to Work Day," where they explored military displays, met with leaders like Secretary Pete Hegseth, and participated in a special reading with Second Lady Usha Vance.

titulo: Air Force Pararescuemen Complete Combat Leader Course
descricao: Air Force pararescuemen assigned to the 68th Rescue Squadron completed the Combat Leader Course at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Ariz., enhancing their operational readiness and leadership skills.

titulo: Hegseth: Flu Vaccine Optional
descricao: Annual influenza vaccines are no longer mandatory, said Secretary of War Pete Hegseth in a video posted on social media. The new mandate follows similar department efforts regarding the COVID-19 vaccine.

titulo: Service Member Olympians Meet With Secretary of War
descricao: Soldiers and airmen who participated in the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympic Games in Italy with the World Class Athlete Program visited the Pentagon, where the athletes also got an unexpected opportunity to meet with Secretary of War Pete Hegseth.

titulo: Department Official Details DOW's Intelligence, Security Priorities
descricao: The undersecretary of war for intelligence and security testified on the resourcing, priorities and challenges facing the intelligence enterprise for fiscal year 2027 during a hearing in Washington.

titulo: U.S. Forces Disable Vessel Attempting to Enter Iranian Port, Violate Blockade
descricao: U.S. forces operating in the Arabian Sea enforced naval blockade measures against an Iranian-flagged cargo vessel attempting to sail toward an Iranian port.

titulo: Nordhaus Underscores National Guard's Indispensable Role
descricao: Air Force Gen. Steven Nordhaus, chief of the National Guard Bureau, testified that 2025's dual-mission operations — from combat strikes in Iran to domestic crisis response — prove the guard needs urgent modernization and funding reform.

titulo: Guard Unit 'Turns Blue,' Symbolizing Mobile Infantry Transition
descricao: The Nevada Army National Guard's 1st Battalion, 221st Cavalry Regiment transitioned from a mounted cavalry formation to a mobile infantry battalion during a "turning blue" ceremony at the Clark County Armory in Las Vegas.

titulo: Air Force, Army, Marines Unite for Joint Air Traffic Control Training
descricao: Airmen, soldiers and Marines completed two weeks of airfield training at Robins Air Force Base, Ga., learning valuable skills while highlighting the power of military interoperability.

titulo: Hegseth Urges Iran to 'Choose Wisely' During Epic Fury Ceasefire, Blockade
descricao: During a Pentagon press briefing, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth urged the new Iranian regime to make wise choices amid a ceasefire in combat operations, and to work in good faith toward a deal with the United States.

titulo: Caine Praises Sailors, Marines Enforcing Iran Blockade
descricao: During a press conference at the Pentagon, Air Force Gen. Dan Caine, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, thanked the sailors and Marines on board vessels in the Persian Gulf enforcing the blockade of ships that sail from Iranian ports.

titulo: Military Leaders Update Congress on Force Readiness, Quality of Life Programs
descricao: Senior leaders from the Army, Navy and Marine Corps provided an update on steps their respective branches are taking to improve the quality of life for service members during a hearing in Washington before the House Armed Services Committee's readiness subcommittee.

titulo: Africom Commences Exercise Flintlock 2026 in Africa
descricao: U.S. Africa Command hosted dual opening ceremonies in Libya and Côte d'Ivoire, officially beginning Exercise Flintlock 2026, its annual combined special operations exercise.

titulo: Army Engineers Conduct Bridge-Building Exercise in Texas
descricao: Army Reserve soldiers assigned to the 401st Engineer Company conducted a multiday bridge-building exercise designed to train new troops and refresh skills at Bardwell Lake, Texas.

titulo: Arkansas National Guard Honors America's 250th Birthday by Enlisting 250 Recruits
descricao: To celebrate America's 250th birthday this year, the Arkansas National Guard enlisted 250 recruits during a ceremony at the MacArthur Museum of Arkansas Military History in Little Rock, Ark.

titulo: Navy Dive Medical Recovery Team Provides Initial Care to Artemis II Crew
descricao: A Navy dive medical team served as the first responders for the Artemis II crew, providing critical assessments and assistance during their safe splashdown and recovery off the coast of San Diego.

titulo: Hegseth, Indonesian Counterpart Announce Defense Partnership
descricao: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth welcomed his Indonesian counterpart — Minister of Defense Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin — to the Pentagon, where the two men announced the establishment of the Major Defense Cooperation Partnership between the two countries.

titulo: U.S. Forces Start Mine Clearance Mission in Strait of Hormuz
descricao: U.S. Central Command forces prepared to start clearing mines in the Strait of Hormuz as two Navy destroyers conducted operations.

titulo: This Week in DOW: Iran Ceasefire, Daring Rescue, Honoring Gold Star Spouses
descricao: This week, the U.S. announced a two-week ceasefire with Iran, as Secretary of War Pete Hegseth hailed the success of Operation Epic Fury in dismantling one of the world's largest militaries, and the War Department observed Gold Star Spouses Day.

titulo: Army Launches Data Operations Center, Giving Warfighters Decisive Edge
descricao: The Army launched the Army Data Operations Center — a key initiative designed to transform how it manages and uses its vast data resources to ensure decision dominance on the modern battlefield.

titulo: White House Honors National Guard-Supported Counterdrug Operations
descricao: The White House Office of National Drug Control Policy recognized personnel assigned to National Guard counterdrug programs for their support to 10 award-winning law enforcement investigations.

titulo: Airmen Launch Remotely Operated Weapon Station Course in Turkey
descricao: The 39th Security Forces Squadron certified airmen on the Common Remotely Operated Weapon Station for the first time at Incirlik Air Base, Turkey, supporting the 39th Air Base Wing's goal for airmen to be trained, equipped and ready.

titulo: Naval Postgraduate School Alumni Lead Artemis II Homebound
descricao: Retired Navy Capt. Reid Wiseman and Navy Capt. Victor Glover — Naval Postgraduate School alumni — are using their years of experience as test pilots, advanced education and astronaut training to guide the Artemis II crew safely back to Earth.
